description: ACT Government publishes this polygon inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. Subtypes include filter chambers, meter chambers, pump wells and valve chambers. The provider describes attributes for depth, surface level, material, lid type and size, lid count, ladder access and surface area. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. The native listing does not state a licence. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, chamber geometry can support asset exposure and access representation; condition and connections to pipes require further evidence. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
